definition: a table between two high benches
description: In a retro American diner a man in a denim jacket sits in a booth with high cream and burgundy padded bench backs around a chrome-edged table with plates of pancakes. A huge brindle Great Dane stands with its front paws on the table. A young waitress in a mint-green uniform and white apron, with a scarf in her dark ponytail, pours coffee from a steel pot into a cup, then pulls the pot back and looks on as the dog lowers its head and drinks from the cup. Men in the next booth watch and grin.

taps.phrase: to pour coffee from a height
